fact: BEMA, an integrated judicial management system, was developed by the company JBSOFT Gabon with magistrates and court auxiliaries and presented by its designer, Jonas Beyeni, at a seminar in Libreville on 10 January 2026; the document states no adoption by the police, the gendarmerie or a ministry.

As its designer describes it, BEMA is built so that the judicial police officer enters the procedure and the software generates the procès-verbal, in a single file per person from arrest to release, passed digitally to the court and the prison; this is the design as presented on 10 January 2026, and the document states no station using it.

BEMA was officially presented on 10 January 2026 at a seminar in Libreville of magistrates and court auxiliaries; the designer says that police, court and prison currently work in isolation, with information re-entered at each; no deployment or adoption decision is stated.
